page: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure VM.Standard.A2.Flex.32-256 is an Arm-based general-purpose virtual machine shape. It is provisioned with 64 dedicated Ampere AmpereOne physical cores operating at a base frequency of 3.0 GHz. Because each physical core runs a single hardware thread, the instance provides 64 dedicated vCPUs without simultaneous multithreading resource contention.

The compute profile is paired with 256.0 GB of system memory, maintaining a standard 1:4 vCPU-to-memory allocation ratio of 4.0 GB per core. The instance includes no local NVMe storage and contains zero GPUs, meaning persistent and high-throughput disk input/output relies entirely on network-attached block storage volumes. One complimentary public IPv4 address is allocated with the instance.

Architecturally, the AmpereOne 64-core Arm64 configuration provides cost efficiency and predictable runtime performance through dedicated single-threaded execution units. It is suited for scale-out cloud workloads, enterprise web serving, microservices frameworks, container orchestration, build pipelines, and general compute environments optimized for 64-bit Arm architectures.
description: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure VM.Standard.A2.Flex.32-256 is a general-purpose virtual machine powered by 64 dedicated physical cores of the 64-bit Arm Ampere AmpereOne processor running at 3.0 GHz. With one thread per core, the shape offers 64 dedicated vCPUs alongside 256.0 GB of memory, preserving a standard 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio of 4.0 GB per core. The instance features no integrated local storage or hardware GPU acceleration, relying on remote block storage for persistent data requirements. It includes one complimentary public IPv4 address. The dedicated single-thread-per-core Arm architecture eliminates hyperthreading interference, delivering predictable CPU throughput and resource density. This configuration is aligned with compute workloads such as containerized microservices, high-traffic web servers, development toolchains, and distributed cloud applications compiled for AArch64 environments.
